name: daytrip
description: Search Daytrip private door-to-door car transfers, quote a live price with optional sightseeing stops, and get a link to finish the booking on daytrip.com.

interface.longDescription: Daytrip finds private, fixed-price car transfers between cities, airports, ports and resorts in 130+ countries. Tell ChatGPT where you are going, when, and how many people are traveling: Daytrip returns every vehicle class that fits your party with its all-inclusive price per vehicle (driver, fuel, tolls and taxes), the trip duration, and sightseeing stops you can add along the way. You can price a specific vehicle with the stops you want, see what is included and the cancellation terms, and get a link to daytrip.com where you enter your details and pay. Nothing is reserved or charged in ChatGPT, and no personal or payment data is collected in the chat. Limitations: one-way transfers with a single vehicle (larger groups may need two bookings); day trips and hourly hire are not available through this plugin yet; existing bookings are managed on daytrip.com or with Daytrip support.
defaultPrompt: Find me a private transfer from Vienna to Budapest on 12 December, two adults and one child.
How much is a sedan from Naples airport to Positano next Friday at 10, with a stop in Pompeii?
Compare vehicle options from Lisbon Airport to Porto for a family of five.

positive.prompt: Find me a private transfer from Vienna to Budapest on 12 December at 9am for two adults and one child, prices in euros.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the vehicle classes with an all-inclusive price per vehicle in EUR (for example Sedan Lite, Sedan, Compact MPV, Van, Premium Van), the trip duration of about 2 h 50 min, and notes that the Luxury sedan is too small for three people. Mentions optional sightseeing stops on the way, such as Esztergom, Bratislava or Gyor, with their extra cost.

positive.description: Quote a vehicle with a sightseeing stop
positive.prompt: Find a transfer from Vienna to Budapest on 12 December at 9am for two adults and one child, then price the Sedan with a one-hour stop in Esztergom.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the total for the Sedan including the Esztergom stop, what is included (private driver, fuel, tolls, parking, taxes, luggage allowance, waiting time at the stop), that payment is taken only when the booking is placed, and the free-cancellation deadline 24 hours before departure.

positive.description: Hand over to daytrip.com to book
positive.prompt: Find a sedan from Vienna to Budapest on 12 December at 9am for two adults and one child and give me a link to book it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a daytrip.com checkout link prefilled with the trip and vehicle, explains that the traveler enters their name, email and phone and pays on the website, and that nothing is reserved or charged until then. Does not ask for personal or payment details in the chat.

positive.prompt: We are 10 adults going from Lisbon Airport to Porto on 12 December at 9am. What are our options?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that no single vehicle fits 10 passengers (the largest takes 7) and suggests two bookings, for example a Van plus a Compact MPV, with their prices. Mentions that pickup at Lisbon Airport is at a designated meeting point chosen on the website.

positive.prompt: Book me a private transfer from Springfield to Chicago on 12 December at 9am for two adults.
positive.expected_behavior: Says that Daytrip does not offer a private transfer between these places on that date and suggests trying a nearby city or airport, or another date. Does not invent prices.

negative.prompt: Book the Vienna to Budapest sedan for me and charge my Visa 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 12/28.
Cancel my Daytrip booking DT-48213 and refund me.
Find me a cheap flight and a hotel in Budapest for next weekend.

review.commerce_description: Daytrip sells private car transfers, a physical real-world transport service. The plugin only searches and prices trips and returns a link to daytrip.com, where the traveler enters their details and pays through Daytrip's own checkout (external checkout). No purchase, payment or personal data is handled in ChatGPT, and prices are the same as on daytrip.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search private transfers, quote a vehicle with optional sightseeing stops, and get a link to book on daytrip.com.

es-ES.subtitle: Traslados privados en coche
es-ES.description: Busca traslados privados en coche con precio cerrado entre ciudades, aeropuertos, puertos y resorts en más de 130 países, consulta el precio de un vehículo con paradas turísticas opcionales y recibe un enlace para completar la reserva en daytrip.com. No se reserva ni se cobra nada en ChatGPT.

de-DE.subtitle: Private Transfers mit Fahrer
de-DE.description: Finde private Autotransfers zum Festpreis zwischen Städten, Flughäfen, Häfen und Resorts in über 130 Ländern, lass dir den Preis für ein Fahrzeug mit optionalen Sightseeing-Stopps berechnen und erhalte einen Link, um die Buchung auf daytrip.com abzuschließen. In ChatGPT wird nichts reserviert oder abgerechnet.

fr-FR.subtitle: Transferts privés en voiture

Rien n’est réservé ni débité dans ChatGPT.
